nom: Exuviance AGE REVERSE+ Advanced Renewal Retinol Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several, including one who says her reactive skin had never tolerated retinol before, report excellent tolerance with no purging or irritation, while at least two others had bad reactions, one broke out and got drier, and another became 'super irritated and red' and stopped using it.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report the serum hydrates rather than dries, with no added flaking or tightness, including one beginner who built up slowly with no issues.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to nearly 60 report visibly softer fine lines and wrinkles, including faded forehead lines and crow's feet, though one 43-year-old long-time retinol user found it too weak for her mature, 'corrective' skincare needs.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and wrinkles, from crow's feet to forehead and between-brow lines, typically within two to four weeks of consistent use; a minority disagree, including one long-time retinol user who found it too weak for her mature, corrective needs, and a couple of others who had not noticed a difference yet or wanted more improvement in a specific area like the forehead.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several who found other retinols drying, say this one hydrates and does not cause dryness, flaking or peeling; dissenters include one whose skin became drier after use and another who experienced slight dryness she considered normal for an active ingredient.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers say the serum reduced redness in their complexion over time, but for a few it caused new redness, ranging from mild redness during the first few uses that settled down within days, to one reviewer whose skin became 'super irritated and red' and who would not use it again.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some who are breakout-prone, say the serum does not clog pores or cause new blemishes, and one credits it with reducing hormonal breakouts; a few disagree, reporting new breakouts around the chin, cheekbones or forehead, with one stopping use because of it and another finding daily use triggered breakouts that settled once she cut back to two or three times a week.
concerns.spots: Reviewers who mention dark spots or hyperpigmentation, including one with years of sun exposure, report visible fading with continued use, generally noticed within about a month.
concerns.oiliness: The only mention of oiliness is a caution from one reviewer that the dewy sheen the serum leaves might not suit oily skin; no reviewer with self-described oily skin reports on the product directly.

aspects.libelle: No noticeable fragrance for most users
Pump can be balky or hard to prime
Requires a slow buildup to avoid irritation
Premium price for the bottle size
Opaque packaging protects the retinol from light

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Advanced Renewal Retinol Serum from Exuviance unfortunately did not work well for my skin. The packaging is pretty and has a pump to evenly distribute the product. It blends into your skin really well and gives an instant facelift effect but at the cost of making making my skin break out around my chin and forehead. My skin actually became drier from using this product.

extraits.titre: Not strong enough for mature skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wanted to love this Exuviance Advanced Retinol Serum.. I received it free for a product review. Even tho it was free to me, I got find the price on Ulta's website to factor that in on my review. Price point was great, however its result not so much. I did not experience any redness or irritation. I'm 43 and have used a ton of Retinol products over the last 15 years, chasing that fountain of youth.. some worked great, but you paid a hefty price for that greatness. I guess it's true to get what you pay for. For my maturing skin, I need a more advanced product. Retinol is listed 14th down in the ingredients, and it doesn't specify the %. I would recommend this product for someone 10-15 years younger, just starting out their beauty routine to maintain what they have. However I would recommend a stronger product for corrective purposes. I gave 3 stars for smell, it is pleasant, and absorption, and price point, not for the results I experienced, unfortunately.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] if you have sensitive skin this is NOT for you. it made my skin super irritated and red. i will not be reaching for this product. if you have skin that isn't sensitive it would be okay for you. it does have a nice texture and no scent which i appreciate, just isn't for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my first time using retinol, and I'm so glad I started with this serum. I have dry skin, so I followed a slow routine to build up. I'm ip to three times a week now. I make sure to use sunscreen daily! I have not had any issues or dryness at all, just visibly more smooth skin. My skin feels smoother, looks brighter, and even has a subtle glow that I haven't seen in a long time. The formula feels silky and absorbs quickly without leaving any residue. It's strong enough to make a difference but gentle enough for my dry, sensitive skin. I'm genuinely impressed with how balanced it feels — effective yet non-irritating. The biggest difference I noticed is in the sea bum buildup on my nose. That has always been an issue for me, but since starting to use this, I haven't noticed a huge difference. If you're new to retinol and nervous about where to start, this is an amazing option. I'm really happy I gave it a try and built it into my nightly routine — it's made a noticeable difference in my skin's texture and overall look.

extraits.titre: Finally a retinol product I can use!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I cannot say enough great things about this retinol serum! I can use it every night without irritation. Until now, my sensitive skin could not tolerate retinol products at all and I've tried many! I'm so impressed by the formula. No purging period, no drying out and my skin is the softest it's ever been. I'm even able to use it under my eyes. It's a truly fantastic product especially for those with reactive skin. Im 40 now and being able to add a retinol product to my routine is so important. Really glad to finally be able to do so with this serum. I love it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] folks let me assure you that this is as honest as I can make it. This stuff rocks! I'm pushing 60 years old and do you see any lines or wrinkles on my face? I have had no procedures done, no fillers, no chemical peels or anything of the sort. I just use the best creams and serums that I can find and I'm definitely going to be adding this to my daily regimen. It soaks in quickly and doesn't feel sticky or tacky. It's never caused any irritation or scaling on my skin. I love it! It's kind of pricey but it's worth it.

extraits.titre: Retinol Cream that Brightens and Smooths
extraits.texte: I have sunspots due to years of living on the beach in Florida. I've tried a few retinol creams in the past. I could truly see a difference within a month of using Exuviance Age Reverse. My brown spots diminished significantly and my skin looked smoother and less red.
